name: Read whom a work cites (its bibliography)
route: POST /api/cross-citations/queries/{query_id}/cited-works/extract → POST …/cited-works/consolidate → GET …/cited-works (+ …/recommend, …/resolve-scholar) · whole thinker: POST /api/thinkers/{thinker_id}/study {budget_usd, phase_limit} · the Stacks' own reading: POST /internal/stacks/thinker-cites, GET /thinkers/{thinker_id}/outward-cites
cost_note: extraction Gemini flash-lite per PDF; consolidation ≈ cents per 40-group chunk; a thinker study is dollars (budgeted)
side_effects: cited-work rows per query (canonical clusters, matches to seeds and the citing pool); study artifacts
gated_by: a PDF must exist; a study needs an explicit budget
yields: cited works with cited_by_seeds, in_external_pool, mutual marks; AI picks
